## Activity

During November 2020, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 36 captures. Capture activity was completed through the site’s scheduled sessions. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. Overall activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 36 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.6 per cent. The ungradable images were excluded from grading. The result should continue to be monitored through routine review of capture quality and session practice.

## Grading

There were 5 referable results during November 2020. The median grading lag was 0. This indicates that the midpoint grading interval was 0, with no delay recorded at the median. Activity, image quality and grading performance should continue to be reviewed together as part of normal site operations.
